raw_source_form: ēāñju mrāṅgā māchēñju, pātēñju; sāḍiki ihiṅgi uḍuṅgu ājānā
raw_interlinear_gloss: he lost was, was-found; therefore so merry having-become

raw_source_form: āmu gipki-mānāmu.’
